During the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], an Imperial flagship was '''destroyed''' in battle with a Republic fleet. The famed [[Rendaran-class assault shuttle|''Rendaran''-class assault shuttle]] ''[[Lucky Lancer]]'', carrying a payload of short-range torpedoes improvised from hundreds of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] and [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] tubing, broke through a screen of Imperial starfighters amidst the fighting and launched its payload directly into the flagship's engines from a distance of just over a kilometer, destroying the vessel.<ref name="Lucky Lancer" />
